article.story: NEW HAVEN, Conn. -- — Nick Townsend scored 20 points as Yale beat Princeton 84-57 on Saturday night. Townsend added seven rebounds for the Bulldogs (16-6, 9-0 Ivy League). Bez Mbeng scored 17 points while shooting 7 for 8, including 3 for 4 from beyond the arc. John Poulakidas had 11 points and shot 4 for 15, including 3 for 9 from beyond the arc. The Bulldogs picked up their 10th straight win. Xaivian Lee finished with 19 points and six rebounds for the Tigers (16-8, 5-4). CJ Happy added seven points for Princeton. NEXT UP Both teams play on Friday. Yale hosts Cornell and Princeton hosts Harvard. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
